claim: PRIVATE SECTION in ABAP class body now updates class-level visibility to 'private' (was silently ignored, defaulting to 'public').
preconditions: Reproduced bug: parser emitted `Class.visibility === 'public'` even when source had `PRIVATE SECTION.` after class header.
Root cause identified: a catch-all `/ SECTION[.\s]*$/u` regex ran BEFORE the explicit PUBLIC/PROTECTED/PRIVATE branches and silently matched `PRIVATE SECTION`, dropping the visibility update.
Fix approved by parent in patcher handoff.
